job.job_description:
We are looking for both AWS with Python, Mid lever AILLM Eng-2




Preferred candid

Job Title:AI/LLM Engineer (Rag and Agentic)

Location: Hybrid / Remote
Department: AI & Data Science
Company: Avira Digital

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced AWS with Python LLM Engineer to drive the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI and GenAI solutions. This role will focus on LLM fine-tuning, prompt optimization, model evaluation, and production deployment for real-world enterprise use cases.

You will lead a small team of ML and AI engineers, collaborating closely with product and architecture teams to deliver scalable and intelligent AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end development of AI and GenAI projects from data preparation to deployment.
Design, fine-tune, and optimize Large Language Models (LLMs) for domain-specific use cases.
Build and manage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and agentic AI systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into production environments.
Evaluate model performance, optimize accuracy, and ensure reliability and efficiency.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building the internal AI knowledge base.
Stay updated on the latest research in GenAI, multimodal learning, and transformer architectures.

Required Skills & Experience

6 years of overall experience in Machine Learning / AI, with at least 2+ years in LLM / GenAI projects.
Proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers (Hugging Face).
Proven experience in fine-tuning and deploying LLMs (e.g., GPT, Llama, Falcon, Mistral, etc.).
Strong understanding of NLP, text embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma).
Experience with LangChain / LlamaIndex and prompt engineering.
Hands-on with cloud environments (AWS / Azure / GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD for ML pipelines, and version control (Git).

Good to Have

Experience in multimodal AI (text, image, voice).
Exposure to open-source LLMs and custom fine-tuning techniques (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA).
Understanding of data privacy, AI governance, and responsible AI practices.
Prior experience in leading small AI/ML teams.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to drive innovation and foster a learning culture within the team.

Education

Bachelors or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field. ate profile
